subject: Supplier activation: invoice cutoff window & early-payment options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: invoice cutoff window & early-payment options

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending the onboarding packet this morning. I pulled the files into our vendor portal and had a couple quick questions so we can finalize the PO routing and payment cadence:

1) What is your standard invoice cutoff (EOD, 12pm PST, 5pm UTC)? Many of our AP batching rules are tied to a cutoff and we'd like to align to avoid delays.
2) Can you confirm your preferred net-term (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60)? If you have flexibility, we'd like to discuss an early-payment option we sometimes run for strategic vendors.

Attached I uploaded a short draft of PO terms (Draft_PO_Terms_v1.pdf) — it's light, mostly around remit details and invoice references. If you can return the completed Supplier_Onboarding_Form.xlsx and W9, we can move to PO issuance.

Next steps I propose: you confirm cutoff + term by end of day Monday, Marissa will set the PO routing, and Karthik will confirm any required fields for the portal. If your AP team prefers a quick call, happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Sales Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192


From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com>

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — our AP team was verifying some bank details. Answers below:

• Invoice cutoff: EOD PST (we can accept both PDFs and portal-uploaded invoices before 23:59 PST).
• Standard net term: Net 45 (we typically invoice at month-end for software services).

We are open to an early-pay program; historically we do a 1% discount for payment within 10 days but haven't formalized it in the onboarding packet. I'll attach the signed W9 and the completed onboarding form by end of day.

Sarah Nguyen
VP Finance Operations
Solstice Technologies
sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com

Attachment: Solstice_W9.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice cutoff window & early-payment options

Thanks Sarah — good to have those details. A couple internal notes and asks so we can provision the PO: 

- Portal requirements: we need the Tax ID formatted on the onboarding sheet (Karthik, FYI).
- Cutoff alignment: EOD PST works for Redwood's AP batch that runs 00:30 UTC on business days — I'll map Solstice to the evening cutoff so invoices submitted before 23:59 PST should get included in the next day's processing.
- Net term: Net 45 is acceptable for initial activation, but we prefer Net 30 where possible for new integrations.

Sergio — can we offer the vendor an early-pay discount pilot? If so, I'll create the PO with two payment options and a note in the invoice instructions. Sarah — if you can confirm the 1% within-10-day discount in writing we can encode it in DocuSign.

I'll attach our onboarding checklist and link to the internal ticket once I spin it up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Programs
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice cutoff window & early-payment options

Quick technicals from AP systems side: 

- PO numbers: we require a valid PO number on the invoice (format: REDW-######). If Solstice will be doing month-end invoices, please ensure each invoice references the PO and the service date range.
- Net term handling: our ERP supports Net 30/45/60 out of the box. Early-pay discounts are implemented as a secondary payment code (e.g., "EP-1pct-10d") and are honored when invoice payment posts within the discount window.
- Attachments: please include a remittance email address in the portal profile to minimize routing errors.

Marissa — once we have the signed W9 and onboarding sheet I'll create the supplier record and issue a draft PO. If the vendor agrees to the 1%/10-day discount, I can include alternate payment terms in the PO so AP can auto-select the discounted schedule when the invoice qualifies.

-Karthik
Finance Systems Manager
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@solstice-tech.com>

Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice cutoff window & early-payment options

Hi all —

Confirming: attached W9 submitted and onboarding sheet completed (see Supplier_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). Solstice agrees to a 1% discount if payment posts within 10 days of invoice receipt. We prefer Net 45 otherwise.

A couple practical asks from our side:
- Please include the invoice submission email accounts in the PO (accounts@solstice-tech.com) to avoid portal-only routing.
- Can Redwood confirm the expected payment posting window after an invoice is submitted? We want to coordinate our cashflow planning; knowing the typical days-to-pay helps.

If that all looks good, happy for Marissa/Karthik to issue the PO and we can sign the DocuSign for the early-pay clause.

Thanks,
Sarah

Attachment: Supplier_Onboarding_Form.xlsx
